question: I have 72% attendance. How many attendance marks will I get?
expected_answer: With 72% attendance, you fall into the 60% – 74.99% tier and will receive 4 marks out of 10.

question: What is the minimum attendance required to avoid being debarred from the Final Exam?
expected_answer: Students with attendance below 60% are debarred from the Final Exam for that subject (receiving 0 marks). The minimum general attendance requirement across courses is 75%.

question: I study at the Ratnam campus. I got sick and need medical leave. Who do I email and how many days do I have to submit my documents?
expected_answer: For Ratnam campus, you must contact/email your Campus Manager, Yashaswini Ma'am. All supporting medical documents must be submitted within 7 days from the last day of illness or treatment.

question: Who is the Campus Manager for the HI-Tech campus, and what is the escalation procedure if my medical leave is rejected by them?
expected_answer: The Campus Manager for HI-Tech campus is Sundaram Sir (L1). If your request is not resolved at the CM level, you can escalate to L2: Dr. Abhilash Karakoti (abhilash.karakoti@msot.org), and finally to L3: Mr. Arpit Sarda (arpit@msot.org).

question: What is the medical leverage cap for attendance and what is the strict deadline to apply for it?
expected_answer: The medical leverage cap is up to 15% (applied to verified medical cases). Supporting documents must be submitted within the strict 7-day window; otherwise absence is marked regular and no relaxation is granted.

question: We want to start a new Cybersecurity society under the Tech Club. Do we ask Management directly?
expected_answer: No, you do not ask Management directly. A new student society proposal requires at least 40% batch support with student signatures and must be submitted to the designated Faculty Coordinator first for initial review.

question: I missed a bunch of classes and only have 81% attendance. Do I get docked all my attendance marks?
expected_answer: No, you do not lose all marks. With 81% attendance, you fall into the 80% – 89.99% tier and will receive 8 marks out of 10.

question: I got hospitalized for typhoid. How much time do I have after getting discharged to give my hospital bills and medical certificate?
expected_answer: You must submit your registered medical practitioner certificate, prescription, and discharge summary within 7 days counted from the last day of illness/treatment or discharge to your Campus Manager.

question: How do I take leave?
expected_answer: The handbook distinguishes between Medical Leave (illness/treatment) and Duty Leave (official competitions/events). Both require submitting official supporting documents to your Campus Manager within 7 days. Casual personal leaves are counted as regular absences.

question: How much is the fine for smoking a cigarette on campus?
expected_answer: Under the Code of Conduct (Page 9), possession or consumption of tobacco/smoking on campus is strictly prohibited and subject to Disciplinary Committee action. The policy handbook does not specify any monetary fine amount.

question: What is the guaranteed placement package or average CTC offered to Mirai CS graduates?
expected_answer: The provided policy handbook does not contain information regarding placement packages, average CTC, or employment guarantees.
key_criteria: not mentioned in the policy handbook

question: What is the night curfew timing for the student hostel?
expected_answer: The provided policy handbook does not specify hostel curfew timings or residential regulations.
key_criteria: not mentioned in the policy handbook
